scenes.description: Benny Bouncing a Red Ball and Clapping Hands Cheerfully
Brushing Teeth and Washing Face Clean at the Morning Mirror
Waving and Calling out to Friends across the Playground

character_line.en: Bounce bounce! Watch the red ball! Can you clap your hands?
character_line.zh: 彈呀彈！看這顆紅球！你能拍拍你的雙手嗎？

options.en: Yes! I can clap my hands and bounce the ball!
options.zh: 可以！我可以拍手也能拍彈球！

options.hint: 跟 Benny 一起開心拍手拍彈球吧！

character_line.en: You bounce it so well! Catch the ball! Did you catch it?
character_line.zh: 你拍得真好！接住球！你有接住它嗎？

options.en: I caught it with both hands! Yay!

options.hint: 接球是「catch（接住）」，抓緊雙手歡呼吧！
開心地跟 Benny 說你順利接住球了！

character_line.en: Morning routine time! What do we do in front of the bathroom mirror?
character_line.zh: 早晨例行作息時間！我們在浴室鏡子前做些什麼？

options.en: I brush my teeth and brush my hair neatly!
options.zh: 我刷牙，並且把頭髮梳理得很整齊！

options.hint: 刷牙或梳頭髮可以用動詞「brush」喔！
告訴 Benny 早上要刷牙梳頭梳理整齊！

character_line.en: Sparkling clean! Should we also wash our faces?
character_line.zh: 乾淨得閃閃發光！我們也要洗洗臉嗎？

options.en: Yes! Wash face with warm water feels so fresh!
options.zh: 要！用溫水洗臉感覺真清爽！

options.hint: 洗臉用動詞「wash」，洗得乾乾淨淨喔！
說說用溫水洗臉有多舒服精神飽滿！

character_line.en: Look across the school yard! Tom is arriving! How do we greet him?
character_line.zh: 看校園另一頭！湯姆到了！我們要怎麼跟他打招呼？

options.en: Wave our hands and call out his name loudly!
options.zh: 揮揮我們的手，並大聲呼喚他的名字！

options.hint: 熱情揮手呼喊湯姆的名字吧！

character_line.en: He waved back and smiled! Playing active games makes us healthy!
character_line.zh: 他向我們揮手並微笑了！進行戶外活動讓我們好健康！

options.en: Yes! Moving and playing together is the best!
options.zh: 沒錯！一起活動一起玩是最棒的！

options.hint: 肯定多多活動對健康最好「Moving and playing...」喔！
跟 Benny 一起跑跑跳跳展開快樂的一天！
